newsitem.title: USA: Anchor gets $130 mln in DIP line of credit.
newsitem.headline: Anchor gets $130 mln in DIP line of credit.

text.p: Anchor Glass Container Corp said Friday it had obtained debtor-in-possession financing worth $130 million to support its liquidity needs when it reorganizes itself after filing for protection under Chapter 11 of the U.S. Bankruptcy Code.
Anchor Glass, a subsidiary of Vitro SA, said it had signed a tentative agreement to sell its assets to Ball-Foster Glass Container Co for $365 million.
Anchor Glass filed for protection to ensure continued operations until the closing of the sale because Vitro had decided to no longer support its liquity needs.
It said the bankruptcy court had entered an interim order approving the financing from Foothill Capital Corp and Congress Financial Corp.
